name: sketchpad-basic
description: Sketchpad Basic helps creators communicate ideas to ChatGPT with drawings, notes, images, and clear visual emphasis.

interface.shortDescription: Show ChatGPT what you mean with a simple sketch.
interface.longDescription: Sketchpad Basic helps creators communicate visual ideas through a simple canvas with drawing tools, color emphasis, text, image pasting, zoom and pan, notes, and a one-click ChatGPT handoff.
interface.defaultPrompt: Interpret this Sketchpad Basic drawing and note together. Treat the sketch as a rough concept, pay close attention to pink highlights, and summarize the creator's intent.
